## 01 · Operator gate
Resolve the bearer token server-side. Only the platform steward can fetch synthetic sources.

## 02 · Read the three feeds
Each request retries independently. A failed feed leaves its previous observations intact.

## 03 · Normalize and commit
Validate taxonomy, extract claims, deduplicate revisions and attest the seed baseline.

## 04 · Detect drift
Call B after durable ingestion. Review candidates never become authoritative here.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ revision: $('Resolve admin and read ledger').first().json.revision, writes: $('Normalize, hash and validate').first().json.writes }) }}

parameters.jsCode: const result = $('Normalize, hash and validate').first().json; return [{ json: { httpCode: $json.httpCode === 200 ? result.httpCode : 207, payload: { ...result.payload, scan: $json.payload } } }];
return [{ json: { httpCode: 409, payload: { status: 'state_changed', message: 'Refresh and retry.' } } }];
return [{ json: $json.actor ? { httpCode: 403, payload: { status: 'denied' } } : { httpCode: 401, payload: { status: 'authentication_required' } } }];
